newsitem.title: UK: Regalian sets rights for London buildings.
newsitem.headline: Regalian sets rights for London buildings.

text.p: Regalian Properties Plc said on Friday it planned a one-for-two rights issue, to raise 16.8 million stg, at a price of 30p per share.

The net proceeds will be used to allow the company to exploit new opportunities in the central London residential market which are being increasingly offered for development, the company said in a statement.

"Reports from independent sources indicate that there has been a substantial uplift in residential prices in central London and that this is likely to continue over the next few years," Regalian chairman David Goldstone said.
"The company has benefited from this buoyancy and the very high level of pre-sales has encouraged us to continue the policy of selective acquisition of major projects for future development."
Alongside the rights announcement, Regalian said it made a pretax profit of 1.6 million stg in the six months to September 30 on turnover of 11.4 million stg.
